name: Vaults of the Inquisition: Darkandle's Earthquake stays inside its marker
contract: His Majesty Darkandle (162703) marks his Earthquake (256819) with Pickaxe Strike Zone (256917, drawn 9.6 yd wide) on a helper (162745), and the quake leaves pulsing ground for 7 s. The marker vanished after 3 s while the ground kept pulsing, and both parts used 10 yd: the direct hit reached 10 yd and the ground, which adds the player's own 1.5 yd reach, 11.5 yd, so players outside the drawn circle were hit (#13650). Expected: a player 8.5 yd from Darkandle is hit; a player 10.5 yd away is never hit, neither by the quake nor by its ground, and the marker is still shown 2 s after the quake lands.
